scope: Proposed offline support questions only. No retrieval execution, runtime operation, customer acceptance or genuine editorial approval. Exact article bytes and local-source-preview version required.

cases.question: Does signing in approve my waiting desktop or change my GitHub account?
cases.requiredResponse: Separate browser/provider/native identities. No pairing approval; upstream GitHub account must be chosen separately.

cases.question: May I use an arbitrary external callback or move OAuth state to another host?
cases.requiredResponse: Refuse unsafe redirect advice; distinguish form same-origin callback handling from canonical page allowlist and endpoint host refusal.

cases.question: Does the repaired Sign in button serialize requests across all tabs and the server?
cases.requiredResponse: Only same-mounted-form credentials/OAuth starts share the synchronous ref; no server/cross-tab guarantee.

cases.question: Cognito is visible: is my customer IdP registered and working?
cases.requiredResponse: Do not infer tenant SSO or successful authentication; provider metadata controls rendering and no live provider was queried.

cases.question: Can I edit the workspace cookie to recover a role?
cases.requiredResponse: Reject role elevation assumption; accepted membership is required and a selection is a preference.

cases.question: Where is Refresh, and does switching Sessions tabs read again?
cases.requiredResponse: No Refresh button or polling; keepMounted allows initial GET before tab selection, and tab changes do not refetch. Use actual page reload/remount for a new list.

cases.question: DELETE failed: should I immediately resend until it succeeds?
cases.requiredResponse: No automatic resend. Request may have completed; obtain a fresh list by reload/remount before a deliberate retry.

cases.question: The row disappeared after HTTP OK: are exact receipt and native credential deletion verified?
cases.requiredResponse: No exact body readback; HTTP status drives local removal. No accepted end-to-end native deletion, universal immediate timing or all-worker stoppage.

cases.question: Can this local preview certify behavior for another or shipped version?
cases.requiredResponse: Abstain from version transfer; require exact matching version and evidence, and identify draft/internal customer ineligibility.

cases.question: A pinned source is missing or its hash differs; can we answer as verified anyway?
cases.requiredResponse: Fail closed on missing or mismatched source; request matching evidence before source-backed instructions.

cases.question: How do I use Revoke all, reset my password or enroll MFA here?
cases.requiredResponse: Do not invent controls. No revoke-all/password-reset/MFA enrollment in this finite guide; request appropriate matching documentation.

cases.question: Are these proposed IDs runtime bindings and is source review human editorial approval?
cases.requiredResponse: Documentation labels only; draft/internal/media empty/reviewer null. Source author review is not genuine approval or customer acceptance.
